source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
**[[PSYCHIC]](vsdata:weapon-ability/psychic)** attacks made by your **ORKS PSYKER** models get +1 **S**, plus another +1 **S** per 5 models in the model's unit (or embarked within that model).

These models also have 2 **psychic abilities**, each of psychic level 1:

**Roar of Mork**: during your Movement phase, provided the model's unit isn't **battle-shocked**, you may roll one D6 as a **psychic roll** for that unit. If you do:

- A roll of 1 makes that unit **battle-shocked**.
- Whatever the result, pick one enemy unit within 12" of it, other than a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit; that enemy unit takes a **battle-shock roll** at -1 per 10 models in the **PSYKER**'s unit.

**Visions of Violence**: as any Fight phase begins, provided the model's unit isn't **battle-shocked**, you may roll one D6 as a **psychic roll** for that unit. If you do:

- A roll of 1 makes that unit **battle-shocked**.
- Whatever the result, that unit has **[Fights First](vsdata:core-ability/fights-first)** for the rest of that phase.
